sources.note: Use for statistical analysis and reporting only; no identification attempts or linkage with individually identifiable data.

usage_note: Publicly available; the official site requires explicit permission for commercial use or redistribution, acknowledgment of Phenol-Explorer and original sources, and citation when significant portions are used. The portal publishes aggregate coverage and provenance, not the composition table or candidate concentrations.
coverage_note: Weighted item and gram coverage are ratios of weighted totals; person-any proportions use WTDRD1 or WTDR2D. Descriptive coverage only; no survey confidence intervals were calculated. Gram denominators include beverages such as water and coffee.
limitations: Phenol-Explorer states that missing composition values do not imply the compound is absent.

A source-unit discrepancy was identified: the Milder et al. abstract reports Brassica total lignans in ug/100g, while some matched workbook entries labeled mg/100g exceed that range; affected candidate values are quarantined.
The current composition release is dated 2016 and does not cover all US food codes or recipes.
The four-compound sum is a partial lignan definition, not total dietary lignan intake.
NHANES flax-seed and sesame-seed descriptions do not exactly match the measured meal/seed preparation states in Phenol-Explorer; they were left unmapped.
No concentration was imputed for mixed dishes, branded products, or uncoded foods, and no dietary lignan-CAP regression was run.
Available urinary ENL/END records are from NHANES 2005-2010; CAP here is NHANES 2017-2018 and there is no SEQN overlap.
